blocks.body: Built on AWS, with Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon Neptune, Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore, Agivant engineers cost into the architecture before the first bill arrives.

blocks.heading: Get Amp'd to move from cloud data to agents in production on AWS
blocks.body: A data and AI stack earns its keep in production. Amp’d is how Agivant gets there. Bolt scaffolds the agent stack, Forward Deployed Engineers build inside the enterprise’s own AWS accounts, and production grade agents reason over data the business already trusts. Each engagement ships with evaluation and rollback, and every hardened pipeline and agent becomes a reusable asset the next build starts from. Every build amplifies the next.

media.alt: Get Amp'd to move from cloud data to agents in production on AWS

data.heading: Why AWS carries a data and AI stack end to end
data.description: When a stack has to run the business, it helps that every piece was built to work with the next. Redshift and an S3 data lake hold the facts. Neptune holds how those facts connect. SageMaker AI and Bedrock turn them into predictions and answers, and AgentCore runs the agents that act on them. Fewer vendors in the chain means fewer places for things to break, and one bill to explain instead of five.

media.alt: Why AWS carries a data and AI stack end to end

data.heading: FinOps, designed in before the first bill arrives.
data.description: Standing up AWS is the easy part. Keeping the bill predictable once agents call foundation models thousands of times a day takes design. Agivant bakes financial accountability, visibility, and cost efficiency into the architecture and into how teams work, so finance watches the cost of AI grow rather than discovering it after the fact.

media.alt: FinOps designed into AWS data and AI architecture

blocks.body: Token budgets per agent and per use case, with prompt caching and batch inference on Amazon Bedrock to curb repeat spend
The lightest Bedrock option that answers well, with larger ones kept for the questions that need them
Every workload tagged to an owner, with AWS Budgets and Cost Explorer showing spend by team and use case
Storage tiers and Savings Plans matched to how each workload runs, with Redshift Serverless scaling down when queries stop
lower token spend and up to 35% lower monthly cloud bill

data.heading: Put four connected layers to work, from data to agents.

headingStructure.highlight: Put four connected layers to work,

data.description: Each layer on AWS makes the next one work better. Clean data sharpens predictions, predictions ground answers, and answers people trust give agents something solid to act on.

blocks.title: DATA
blocks.heading: Get the data ready, and keep it fresh.
blocks.body: Agivant pulls data out of your transactional systems with AWS Glue, lands it in an Amazon S3 data lake, and shapes it into tables Amazon Redshift can query fast. With streaming through Amazon Kinesis, dashboards run minutes behind the business. Amazon Neptune maps how customers, accounts, suppliers, and assets connect, so the next question already has context.

blocks.title: AI/ML
blocks.heading: Predict what happens next.
blocks.body: Much of the value in enterprise AI still comes from good predictive data science. Agivant builds forecasting, churn, pricing, and anomaly detection on Amazon SageMaker AI, and retrains it automatically as new data lands. Analysts can call predictions straight from SQL with Amazon Redshift ML.

blocks.title: GENAI
blocks.heading: Ask in plain English, and see what changed and why.
blocks.body: Assistants on Amazon Bedrock answer the questions your business actually asks: where sales dipped, which customers are drifting, which anomaly needs attention this week, which events to watch next. A semantic layer of business definitions sits underneath, so recognized revenue and gross margin mean exactly what your finance team agrees they mean. Every answer shows its source and its definition, because an answer nobody can explain is hard to act on.

blocks.title: AGENTIC AI
blocks.heading: Agents recommend the next best action, then follow through.
blocks.body: Once an answer is clear, the agent lays out the next best action and what each option is likely to change. Your people pick the call, and agents carry it out: raise the ticket, reconcile the invoice, tell the customer, update the forecast. Agivant builds and runs them on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, which gives every agent an identity, memory, a gateway to enterprise tools, and full observability.

Every Agivant agent is production grade from day one, observable and always on. Each one carries its own identity in AWS, and a person approves anything that moves real money or carries real risk. Routine steps run on their own, and the calls that need judgment route to the team that owns them.

media.alt: Keep teams in control while agents run the work

headingStructure.highlight: Scale on AWS with Well-Architected engineering.

blocks.body: Agivant builds inside your own AWS accounts, so data and agents sit on the infrastructure the enterprise already runs. Every build follows the AWS Well-Architected Framework across all six pillars, and Forward Deployed Engineers work in focused sprints. This is what an Amp’d enterprise looks like in production.

media.alt: Scale on AWS with Well-Architected engineering
